question: Which 10 banks have the largest total assets?
sql: SELECT CERT, NAME, ASSET, ROA, ROE FROM ds_fdic_institutions ORDER BY ASSET DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

question: Compare average ROE across bank classes
sql: SELECT BKCLASS, AVG(ROE) AS avg_roe, COUNT(*) AS num_banks FROM ds_fdic_institutions WHERE BKCLASS IS NOT NULL AND ROE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BKCLASS ORDER BY avg_roe DESC

question: Show total industry assets by year
sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(REPDTE, 1, 4) AS report_year, SUM(ASSET) AS total_assets, COUNT(*) AS num_reports FROM ds_fdic_financials WHERE ASSET IS NOT NULL GROUP BY report_year ORDER BY report_year
